translation.name: Biblica® Wɔnhia ɛho kwamma nwoma Asante Twi Nkwa Asɛm

content: Kɛntɛn A Aduaba A Abereɛ Wɔ Mu
Afei, deɛ Otumfoɔ Awurade yi kyerɛɛ me nie: kɛntɛn a aduaba a abereɛ wɔ mu.
Ɔbisaa sɛ, “Ɛdeɛn na wohunu, Amos?” Mebuaa sɛ, “Kɛntɛn a wɔde nnuaba a abereɛ ahyɛ no ma.” Ɛna Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, “Me nkurɔfoɔ Israelfoɔ berɛ no aso; meremfa wɔn ho nnkyɛ wɔn bio.”
Sɛdeɛ Otumfoɔ Awurade seɛ nie, “Saa ɛda no, asɔrefie nnwontoɔ bɛdane menabɔ. Wɔbɛbɔ afunu bebree apete baabiara! Enti yɛ komm!”

content.text: Montie saa asɛm yi, mo a motiatia mmɔborɔwafoɔ so,
na mopam ahiafoɔ firi wɔn asase so,
“Ɛberɛ bɛn na ɔbosome foforɔ bɛtwam
ama yɛatɔn aduane,
na Homeda bɛba awieeɛ
ama yɛadi ayuo dwa?”
Sɛ mobɛhyɛ susukora mu
na moatoto ɛboɔ so
na mode nsania a wɔamia mu asisi atɔfoɔ,
na mode dwetɛ atɔ ahiafoɔ
na mmɔborɔwafoɔ nso moatɔn wɔn agye mpaboa,
na moapra ayuo ase afra ayuo mu atɔn.

content: Awurade de Yakob ahohoahoa aka ntam sɛ: “Me werɛ remfiri biribiara a wɔayɛ da.

content.text: “Asase renwoso wɔ deɛ asie yi ho anaa,
na wɔn a wɔte mu nyinaa ntwa adwo anaa?
Asase no nyinaa bɛpagya ne ho te sɛ Nil
ɛbubu afa so, na asane atwe bio
te sɛ Misraim asubɔnten.”
“Saa ɛda no, mɛma owia atɔ owigyinaeɛ,
na mama esum aduru asase so awia ketee.
Mɛdane mo nyamesom apontoɔ ama ayɛ awerɛhoɔdie
na mo nnwontoɔ nyinaa adane osu.
Mɛma mo nyinaa afira ayitoma
na mayi mo tirinwi.
Mɛyɛ saa da no te sɛ ɔba korɔ ho awerɛhoɔdie da
na awieeɛ no ayɛ sɛ da a ɛyɛ nwono.
“Nna no reba” sɛdeɛ Otumfoɔ Awurade seɛ nie,
“Mɛma ɛkɔm aba asase no so,
ɛnnyɛ aduane ɛkɔm anaa nsukɔm,
na mmom, Awurade asɛm ho ɛkɔm.
Nnipa bɛtɔ ntentan akyinkyin firi ɛpo so akɔ ɛpo so
na wɔakyinkyini afiri atifi fam akɔ apueeɛ fam,
sɛ wɔrekɔhwehwɛ Awurade asɛm,
nanso wɔrenhunu.
“mmabaawa ahoɔfɛfoɔ ne mmarimaa ahoɔdenfoɔ
bɛtotɔ baha ɛsiane osukɔm enti.
Wɔn a wɔde Samaria aniwuo abosom ka ntam,
anaa wɔde Dan ne Beer-Seba abosom ka ntamka no,
wɔbɛhwehwe ase na wɔrensɔre bio.”

footnotes.text: 8.8 Yiri tɛnn te se Nil: Osu a ɛtɔ berɛ ano berɛ ano wɔ Etiopia no ma Asubɔnten Nil a ɛwɔ Misraim yiri bu fa so bɛyɛ anammɔn 25 ma ne subɔnhwa no yɛ ma. Nsuyire yi saa dɔte pa kɔgu asase no so.
